title: Battle of al-Kawiya
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of al-Kawiya", at revision 1370597364, opens: "The Battle of al-Kawiya was a military conflict between the Alawi Sultanate and the Regency of Algiers in September, 1700. The Moroccans suffered a defeat and heavy casualties including a large number of commanders." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q138544936, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1700 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
